subject: Argentum - Private Deployment Ops Questionnaire and Implementation Constraints
messages:
From: Amelia Reyes <amelia.reyes@argentumtx.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private deployment questionnaire & constraints

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Argentum is evaluating a sealed, physically isolated deployment for regulated workloads (PHI, clinical trial data). Procurement and our security engineering team asked for a detailed capability questionnaire that covers: network egress controls, operator access model, KMS/HSM integrations, upgrade/patch workflow, emergency patching and rollback, telemetry/audit export options, and evidence of separation of duties for operators.

I attached our short RFI (Argentum_RFI_20280705.pdf). Can Redwood provide a completed questionnaire and an implementation constraints list that we can circulate internally? We are targeting an on-site runbook validation window in August.

Two things to note up front: 1) we cannot permit any outbound model telemetry to third-party services, and 2) all operator access must be auditable and tied to our SSO plus per-session justification.

Please let me know a target date for the questionnaire and whether you can include a sample operator handoff checklist and your suggested validation steps for a sealed deployment.

Best,
Amelia
Director, IT Procurement
Argentum Therapeutics

[Attachment: Argentum_RFI_20280705.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Reyes <amelia.reyes@argentumtx.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment questionnaire & constraints

Amelia —

Thanks for the RFI and the clear constraints. I've attached our Private Deployment Ops Questionnaire (redwood_private_deploy_questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and an abbreviated implementation constraints memo. Highlights up front:

- We support fully isolated deployments with zero egress by default; optional telemetry exports are configurable and can be disabled entirely.
- KMS integrations: bring-your-own KMS via standard KMIP/AWS KMS interfaces; HSM options for on-prem appliances.
- Operator access: we support short-lived operator sessions, SSO-backed RBAC, session recording hooks, and per-action justification.
- Upgrade model: rolling node-by-node updates with canary and rollback points; we document a step-by-step operator checklist.

Can your team share a contact for security engineering who will own the technical verification? Also, do you have an internal NDA or SOW format we should use before we share any runbooks?

I'll loop in Irene for technical answers and Vanessa for commercial/SLA questions. Target: we'll return a completed questionnaire and a draft runbook excerpt by EOD July 7.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_private_deploy_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Team —

FYI: Argentum (Amelia Reyes, Carlos Medina) wants a completed ops questionnaire plus a deployment constraints list. Irene — can you take the primary technical reply? Please include the following in your response:

- Operator credential model and session auditing details (we need exact commands for session recording enablement)

Jordan — can you draft a concise SOW clause about maintenance windows and remediation SLAs we can share with Vanessa for contracting?

I'll coordinate a 60- to 90-minute workshop with their security engineers if we need to walk through the runbook.

Sean

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Reyes <amelia.reyes@argentumtx.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Jul 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Argentum - Private Deployment Ops Questionnaire and Implementation Constraints

Amelia —

Appreciate the clarity in your RFI. Below is our technical reply (high-level answers first, then a short appendix with exact operator checklist steps and a sample KMIP snippet). I attached a short runbook excerpt (redwood_private_runbook_v1.docx) for your validation. If you need full runbook access we can provide it under NDA/SOW.

High-level principles
- Zero external telemetry: we can deploy with all optional telemetry sinks disabled and block outbound to all third-party endpoints. Local telemetry is retained on customer-managed storage; we can provide a signed manifest for verification.
- KMS/HSM: we support both on-prem HSMs (PKCS#11) and cloud KMS (AWS/Azure/GCP). For sealed deployments we recommend an on-prem HSM or a KMIP-compatible appliance behind your firewall. Credential rotation is supported via our key-rotation controller; we document per-key rotation steps in the runbook.
- Operator access model: we integrate with SAML/OIDC SSO for authn, provision short-lived operator accounts via an ephemeral token broker, and capture all operator CLI/API sessions with timestamps, user principal, and per-action justification metadata. Session artifacts are stored locally and can be exported as a time-stamped tarball for audit.
- Upgrades & rollback: our recommended path is node-by-node canary -> monitor -> progressive rollout -> rollback at the last known good canary if regressions are detected. We include automated snapshot/kv-cache persistence points to minimize data loss during rollback.

Appendix (selected excerpts)
1) Network requirements (customer-side):
   - Private routed subnet(s) with no default route to the public internet; egress must be explicitly allowed and audited.
   - Internal DNS resolvable entries for orchestration controller and all GPU nodes.
   - NTP from an internal source to ensure monotonic timestamps for audit logs.

2) KMIP example (snippet) and credential flow:
   - Example: connect to kmip://10.11.12.5:5696 with mutual TLS cert binding. Our controller uses a local key-encryption-key (KEK) wrapper; master keys remain in the HSM.

3) Operator handoff checklist (excerpt):
   - Confirm operator identity via SSO with MFA asserted
   - Record per-session justification field: maintenance|incident|validation
   - Enable session recording and verify recording endpoints are present on local disk
   - Run pre-change health checks (latency, token-throughput, kv-cache hit rate)
   - Perform canary step and validate model inference correctness on a pinned prompt set
   - If success, continue progressive rollout; otherwise, trigger rollback and capture post-mortem artifacts

4) Evidence & attestation we can provide:
   - Signed runbook excerpt (included)
   - A sample operator session transcript with hash-signed archive for audit
   - A change-log manifest for package versions and kernel optimizations applied during install

Next steps
- We will finalize the completed questionnaire spreadsheet and send it by EOD Monday (July 10) if you confirm that sharing the full runbook will be under your standard NDA/SOW.
- Suggest a 90-minute technical validation workshop the week of August 14 to exercise the operator handoff and an upgrade rollback scenario in a sealed verification environment.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Deployment Engineering, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_private_runbook_v1.docx (document)]
